name: チャンネル権限の同期案内
prompt:
Recreate the Japanese permission-sync notice shown in the primary native preview. Match the exact 390x118 canvas proportion, white background, positions and text. This is a faithful reconstruction, not a redesign.

At the upper left, show the exact small muted-gray sentence 「この権限は分類「交流の会話」と同期していません。」 around x16 y11 in one line. Below it, place one pale-mint rounded action bar at x16 y46, about 358x58 with a gentle 12px radius. Inside the bar, place a small forest-green down-chevron near x34 y72 and the exact dark forest-green bold label 「今すぐ同期」 starting near x72 y67. Keep the compact button height and restrained style.

This component contains no hyperlink text. 「今すぐ同期」 is a button action, not a hyperlink, so keep its native dark-green text on the pale-mint button. If an actual hyperlink label is visible, render only the linked words blue. The blue Edit label in the original full-screen source is outside the selected region and must not be added. Do not add sync-arrow icons; the native Japanese component uses a down-chevron.

Exclude all other screen chrome, tabs, navigation, headings and permission rows. Use the native preview as the exact authority for Japanese wording, button treatment and geometry; use the original source only as context for the unsynced-permission meaning.
reviewNotes: v001を実画像で目視。日本語案内と「今すぐ同期」ボタン、森林緑の下向きシェブロンを保持。リンク文言なし。出力2172x724はnative390x118より縦長。ボタン幅は約339pxでnative358pxより短く、高さも約53pxで58pxより低い。上端は約y51でnative y46より5px下だが、下端は概ね揃う。v2ではキャンバスを横長にし、ボタン幅/高さ/上位置を修正する。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
